protocol.source_only: Compile existing development-only full source mode and low-dynamics adapters against the separately pinned LAL source and wheel. Generate the same exact row at the requested Momega=0.04 and cap Momega=10^-3/2. Verify identical low arrays/NQC coefficients, unique exact h22 suffix, discrete epoch offset, and requested-frequency replay against the frozen v5 source control. No native waveform is run in this stage.
protocol.epoch_definition: Pinned non-PA v4 C sets tc=-Msec*(low restart time+high relative orbital-frequency peak time) before crop, then adds kMin*deltaT. The cap-frequency call takes fStart=fMin and kMin=0, exposing the uncut corrected mode. Its GPS epoch yields the source orbital peak time up to nanosecond rounding. Compare that time to the low-array endpoint, and map cropped sample i to cap time (kMin+i)*0.5 M only when the suffix and epoch gates pass.
protocol.failure_policy: Write a failed_validity result with numerical controls if any finite/suffix/epoch/dynamics/NQC/replay check fails. Do not use a failed source stage for native cross-model phase attribution.
protocol.resource_bound: One serial local source-only run: two full-mode calls, two low-dynamics calls, two NQC coefficient calls and two adapter compiles; expected 30-90 seconds, budget 3 minutes and under 1 GiB. No production or pinned-source edits.
